gaps: A reversed signature for dark grounds. Every signature published here is Midnight ink and works only on Parchment or white. Nothing signed may appear on Midnight, Word Blue, or footage until a reversed master exists. Recolor the SVG fill rather than inverting the raster.

Revival To My City has no approved mark. Eight explorations are published under assets/logos/rtmc-explorations/ for selection. The chosen direction must be redrawn as vector, in Midnight and reversed, before it is used on anything. Until then RTMC is set as type.

Location on every July 2026 caption is recorded as Sanga, Mbarara, Uganda from the capture folder and has not yet been confirmed against the official ministry record. Confirm it, then unbracket the older captions that still read [City].

Wordmark masters in SVG and 2x/3x PNG (White, Midnight, Word Blue) are recorded as approved in Brand Guide §06 but are not yet published in this repository. Until they are, request them rather than recreating the mark.
